---
title: "CLIC — Study Summary"
params:
  study: "Study"
  data: NULL
  pages: NULL
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
d      <- params$data
study  <- params$study
pages  <- params$pages
if (is.null(pages)) pages <- unique(as.character(d$page))
SHORT <- c("Genomic Pipeline"="Genomic Pipeline","Phenotype Data"="Phenotype Data",
           "Epi Data"="Epi Data","IARC DCC Transfer"="IARC DCC")
disp <- function(p) if (p %in% names(SHORT)) unname(SHORT[p]) else p
has_proj <- !is.null(d) && "project" %in% names(d)
has_canc <- !is.null(d) && "cancer"  %in% names(d)
```

# `r study`

Generated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` from the CLIC dashboard.

```{r results='asis'}
if (!is.null(d) && nrow(d)) {
  is_globall <- has_proj && any(d$project == "GlobALL")
  canc <- if (has_canc) unique(d$cancer[nzchar(d$cancer)]) else character(0)
  tags <- c(if (is_globall) "GlobALL project" else NULL,
            if (length(canc)) paste0("Cancer types: ", paste(canc, collapse = ", ")) else NULL)
  if (length(tags)) cat("*", paste(tags, collapse = " \u00b7 "), "*\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) {
  cat("No records found for this study.\n\n")
} else {
  for (pg in pages) {
    dp <- d[d$page == pg, ]
    dp <- dp[order(dp$col_order), ]
    cat("\n## ", disp(pg), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (!nrow(dp)) { cat("*No record for this study in this tab.*\n\n"); next }
    meta <- c(unique(dp$country[nzchar(dp$country)]),
              unique(dp$institution[nzchar(dp$institution)]))
    if (length(meta)) cat("*", paste(meta, collapse = " \u00b7 "), "*\n\n", sep = "")
    print(kable(data.frame(Milestone = dp$milestone, Status = dp$status),
                row.names = FALSE))
    notes <- unique(dp$notes[nzchar(dp$notes)])
    if (length(notes)) cat("\n\n**Notes:** ", paste(notes, collapse = "; "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

---

<small>Status reflects what is currently entered in clic_data.xlsx; blank values are shown as "Not started" and are awaiting confirmation.</small>
